rule: Water moves bodies: every water skill shoves, drags or sets up a shove, and a shoved body that hits something is Crushed.

skills.name: Water Bolt
skills.summary: First enemy hit is Soaked and knocked back a step.
skills.verb_fit: Surge is "push bodies away": the bolt exists to knock its target back a step.

good_modifiers.word: Seeping Bolt: soaks through the first body and carries on, Soaking and shoving every one in the line
Gushing Bolt: a faster, harder jet; easier to land on a runner
Choking Bolt: a mouthful of water - interrupts and Dazes what it hits

bad_modifiers.why: a thrown bolt does nothing to its caster; no duration to stretch, falls back to a little power
a bolt has nothing that lasts; falls back to a little power
pull 1.5 on a bolt that shoves 1.5: the two cancel and the target stays put. Maths lets it act; it should not

skills.name: Breaker
skills.summary: A wide blow that throws everyone it hits 4 m away from you. Stand so the wall is behind them.
skills.verb_fit: Surge made into a blow: every enemy in the arc is thrown 4 m away from you.

good_modifiers.word: Drenching Breaker: everyone hit is Soaked as they go, so the same blow throws them half as far again
Rolling Breaker: a wider arc that also hammers poise
Wide Breaker: a broader, longer arc for crowds, at a little less damage

bad_modifiers.why: a melee arc has nothing to pierce; falls back to a little power
nothing lasts and nothing lands on you; falls back to a little power
a pull added to a 4 m throw: the blow drags in and throws out at once. Maths lets it act; it should not

skills.name: Sluice Step
skills.summary: A short dash straight through enemies. Each one you pass is Soaked and swept 2 m along with you, the way you are going.
skills.verb_fit: Sweep is "a current that carries things along": you are the current, and what you pass goes with you.

new_mechanics.name: shove_dir "along"
new_mechanics.definition: A dash payload's shove pushes the body the way the dash is travelling, not away from the caster.

good_modifiers.word: Torrent Step: the bodies you pass are thrown on much farther - drive a line of them into the far wall
Jet Step: a faster dash
Choking Step: everyone you pour through comes out interrupted and Dazed
a quicker dash

bad_modifiers.why: it already passes through bodies; pierce has nothing to add and falls back to a little power
a dash lasts 0.18 s and leaves nothing; falls back to a little power
its own opposite: Mired in the moment they are swept along - the current both carries and drops them. Maths lets it act; it should not

skills.name: Undertow
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: every enemy within 4 m of the spot is dragged up to 4 m toward it and Soaked. No damage of its own - but bodies that collide Crush each other.
skills.verb_fit: Ebb is "draw bodies in": the floor leans and everything slides to one spot.

good_modifiers.word: Silting Undertow: they arrive and stick - Mired where they piled up
Drowning Undertow: the whole gathered knot is interrupted and Dazed
Tight Undertow: a smaller net that packs them closer
Wide Undertow: a bigger net

bad_modifiers.why: a push away from the point inside a pull toward it: the two fight. Maths lets it act; it should not
nothing to pierce; falls back to a little power (and it deals no damage, so to cost)
it acts on a spot on the floor, not on you; falls back

skills.name: Riptide Lash
skills.summary: One enemy within 10 m is hauled to arm's length, takes 60, is Soaked and interrupted - and arrives with its back to you for a second.
skills.verb_fit: Ebb for one body: a rope of water that hauls a single enemy in.

good_modifiers.word: Choking Lash: it arrives Dazed as well as interrupted - take +50% for 3 s
Long Lash: a longer rope for the archer at the back
Single Lash: the one body takes more from the yank

bad_modifiers.why: shove 1.5 on a body you are hauling in: it lands a step short of you, which undoes the skill. Maths lets it act
nothing to pierce; falls back to a little power
a yank has nothing that lasts; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Standing Pool
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: a pool 3.5 m across for 8 s. Enemies in it are Soaked and 30% slower, and a shove that starts in it goes twice as far. No damage.
skills.verb_fit: Flood is "fill an area with water": a pool that stays and turns the ground wet.

good_modifiers.word: Whirlpool: every half second the pool drags those in it toward its middle
Slow Pool: it lingers 40% longer and costs less
Lasting Pool: it stays half as long again
Wide Pool: a larger pool

bad_modifiers.why: a pool does not jet: no speed and no damage, falls back to a cost cut
nothing to pierce; falls back to a cost cut
maths lets it through, but on a payload that repeats every tick it re-interrupts every tick: a permanent lock, not a modifier

skills.name: Backwash
skills.summary: 6 s or three blows, whichever ends first: each melee hit on you is halved, and the water splashes off you - whoever threw the blow, and everyone else within 2 m of you, is shoved 3 m and Soaked.
skills.verb_fit: Splash is "burst outward on contact, spraying those near": the blow lands, and the water bursts off you onto everyone close.

new_mechanics.name: Backwash payload
new_mechanics.definition: The splash is now an on_hit payload (shove 3, Soaked) applied to the attacker and to everyone within radius (2 m) of you, so modifiers can reach it; it replaces the old top-level shove.

good_modifiers.word: Heavy Backwash: the splash throws them much farther
Long Backwash: it stays up longer
Rolling Backwash: a wider splash
Choking Backwash: whoever is splashed is also interrupted and Dazed

bad_modifiers.why: nothing to pierce; falls back to a cost cut
no speed and no damage to raise; falls back to a cost cut
a pull on a skill whose point is throwing attackers off you: it drags them back into reach. Maths lets it act; it should not

skills.name: Pressure Jet
skills.summary: Hold: an 8 m stream, 1 m wide, at the first enemy in the line: 90 damage a second and it is pushed back 5 m a second. Pinned against a wall or stone it takes 1.5x. You turn slowly and walk at 45% while holding. 10 essence a second.
skills.verb_fit: Gush is "a sudden forceful jet": this is the jet, held.

new_mechanics.name: new:channel
new_mechanics.definition: design/05 Appendix A behaviour 8 (not built): held, essence per second (cost with cost_per_s), payload every tick to the first enemy on the line.

good_modifiers.word: Fire-hose: the stream throws as well as presses
Needle Jet: a shorter, harder stream
Long Jet: reaches across the room

bad_modifiers.why: a channel already lasts as long as you hold it; nothing to stretch, falls back to a little power
it acts on what you point at; falls back
a pull added to a stream that pushes: each tick drags in and pushes out. Maths lets it act; it should not

skills.name: Drawdown
skills.summary: Every Soaked enemy within 8 m has the water torn out of it toward you: its Soak ends and it is dragged 3 m toward you. You get 2 essence back for each. Your Standing Pool in range empties toward you too, dragging those in it twice as far, and is gone.
skills.verb_fit: Drain is "empty the water from an area or a target, and draw it in": it empties every Soak and pool in reach and the water comes to you, bringing the bodies with it.

new_mechanics.name: refund_per_stack
new_mechanics.definition: Essence returned to the caster for each status stack the skill consumes, never more than the skill cost.

new_mechanics.name: pool_pull_mult
new_mechanics.definition: Enemies standing in one of the caster's own water zones within range are pulled this many times as far, and the zone ends.

good_modifiers.word: Deep Drawdown: drags them farther
Silting Drawdown: they land at your feet Mired
Wide Drawdown: reaches Soaked enemies farther off
Choking Drawdown: everything drained is interrupted and Dazed as it comes

bad_modifiers.why: shoves the drained bodies away while the water drags them in. Maths lets it act; it should not
nothing to pierce; falls back to a cost cut
it is one pull, nothing lasts; falls back to a cost cut

skills.name: Drench
skills.summary: Point, 10 m: a cloudburst gathers for 0.6 s, then falls on a 3 m circle. Everyone under it is Waterlogged for 6 s and interrupted. A Waterlogged heavy enemy is shoved as if it were light, and an elite as if it were heavy.
skills.verb_fit: Soak is "saturate a target": this soaks them through until the water is doing the work of moving them.

new_mechanics.name: waterlogged
new_mechanics.definition: 6 s, 1 stack. Counts as Soaked (shoves x1.5, conducts). The target is also shoved as one weight class lighter: heavy as light, elite as heavy.

good_modifiers.word: Beating Rain: the downpour also flattens them outward from the middle
Wide Drench: a bigger cloud
Sudden Drench: falls sooner, harder to step out of
Mudding Drench: Mired as well

bad_modifiers.why: nothing to pierce; falls back to a cost cut
a cloudburst over a spot, not over you; falls back to a cost cut
falling rain has no speed and no damage to raise; falls back to a cost cut

skills.name: Wringing Grip
skills.summary: One enemy within reach: you grip it and wring the water out. A 1.6x blow, +90 if it was Soaked (+180 if Waterlogged) - the grip uses the Soak up - and it reels back 1 m. Little more than a slap on a dry target.
skills.verb_fit: Dry is "pull the water out of a body: damage by how wet it is": the damage is the water you take out.

new_mechanics.name: waterlogged_stacks
new_mechanics.definition: A consume_status of soaked counts a Waterlogged target as this many stacks.

good_modifiers.word: Wring and Throw: the dried body is flung back, not just staggered
Choking Grip: it reels back interrupted and Dazed
Hard Grip: more from the one body

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: Soaks the body as you wring it dry. Maths lets it act; it undoes the skill
a grip has nothing to pierce; falls back to a little power
nothing lasts; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Upwelling
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: a spring bursts up under everyone within 2.5 m. 30 damage; light enemies are lifted Aloft and come down 2 m out from the spring (4 m, since Aloft doubles a shove). Heavy enemies lose 50 poise and slide 1 m.
skills.verb_fit: Float is buoyancy - "lift, lighten": the water lifts them off their feet, and a floating body goes wherever the water sends it.

new_mechanics.name: shove_dir "from_point"
new_mechanics.definition: A shove in a point-cast payload pushes each body away from the aimed point.

good_modifiers.word: Geyser: they come down much farther out
Wet Spring: Soaked as they fly, half as far again
Wide Spring: catches more of the pack

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: held under while being floated. Maths lets it act; it should not
knocks flat what it just lifted, and it has no poise field: falls back to a little power
nothing to pierce; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Drowning Hold
skills.summary: One enemy within 8 m: a ball of water closes over its head for 3 s. It is interrupted, cannot attack, cast, drum or call for help, and takes 20 at once and 15 a second. When the water lets go it heaves the enemy 3 m away from you, so put the wall behind it first.
skills.verb_fit: Drown is "water in the lungs: no casting, no calls for help, damage over time" - all three, on one body.

new_mechanics.name: new:seize
new_mechanics.definition: An instant effect on the one enemy under the cursor (or your locked target) within range; walls and stone block it; it is checked before essence is spent. With a delay, the target is marked and the hit lands that many seconds later wherever it has moved.

new_mechanics.name: drowning
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, lasts the skill's duration. Cannot attack, cast, drum or call for reinforcements; 15 damage a second through the caster; ends early after 150 damage taken.

new_mechanics.name: release_shove
new_mechanics.definition: When the skill's status ends, the target is shoved this far away from the caster (a Crush if it meets something).

good_modifiers.word: Long Hold: held under longer
Soaked Hold: it comes out Soaked, so the heave throws it half as far again
Reaching Hold: catch the drummer at the back

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: Aloft while held under. Maths lets it act; it should not
nothing to pierce; falls back to a little power
there is no wind-up to shorten; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Steady Drip
skills.summary: Cheap. One enemy within 10 m drips for 10 s: every second it is nudged half a step away from you and loses 8 poise, and its poise does not recover while it drips. Leave it on a big enemy and it staggers on its own.
skills.verb_fit: Drip is "a slow steady trickle that wears and lingers": a little, every second, for a long time.

new_mechanics.name: dripping
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, lasts the skill's duration. Every second: nudged nudge_per_s away from the caster (too soft to Crush) and loses poise_per_s poise; poise does not regenerate while Dripping.

good_modifiers.word: Endless Drip: lasts half as long again
Wet Drip: each nudge goes half as far again
Distant Drip: start it on someone across the room

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite, a sudden jet; and it has no speed or damage to raise: falls back to a cost cut
no wind-up to shorten; falls back
nothing to pierce; falls back

skills.name: Siltfall
skills.summary: Everything you moved settles. Every enemy within 10 m that a water skill shoved or dragged in the last 1.5 s sinks where it now stands: Pinned (60% slower) for 2 s and 30 poise. Bodies still sliding finish their slide first.
skills.verb_fit: Settle is "the water goes still, and what it carries sinks and stays": it acts only on what your water has carried.

new_mechanics.name: adrift
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, 1.5 s. Put on any body when a water shove or pull on it ends. Nothing on its own; Siltfall consumes it.

good_modifiers.word: Sinking Silt: they go under as they settle - interrupted and Dazed
Heavy Silt: knocked down harder, more poise
Wide Silt: reaches what you threw farthest

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: a current that carries them on, the moment they settle. Maths lets it act; it should not
nothing to pierce; falls back to a cost cut
no speed and no damage; falls back to a cost cut

skills.name: Seepage
skills.summary: One enemy within 9 m: water soaks in under its guard for 0.6 s, then wells up behind it - 50 damage that ignores its shield and armour, and a 1.5 m tug toward you. For 4 s its shield and armour count for nothing, against anyone.
skills.verb_fit: Seep is "soak in slowly, getting behind shields and armour": slow to arrive, and it arrives behind the shield.

new_mechanics.name: seeped
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, lasts the skill's duration. The target's front block and armour do nothing.

new_mechanics.name: ignores block
new_mechanics.definition: The hit that applies Seeped already ignores front block and armour.

good_modifiers.word: Saturating Seep: Soaked through as well
Drawing Seep: the tug becomes a real drag out of the shield line
Quick Seep: wells up sooner
Lasting Seep: the guard stays open longer

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: bursting outward on contact is exactly what seeping in is not. Maths lets it act
nothing travels; no speed to raise, falls back to a little power
no poise to raise and nothing to knock down; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Tidal Bore
skills.summary: Dear. A wall of water 5 m wide rolls 12 m forward from you. Everyone it meets is picked up and carried to where it breaks: 45 damage, Soaked, 30 poise. If it breaks against a wall, everyone it carries is Crushed. Heavy enemies are dropped halfway; elites split it.
skills.verb_fit: Wave is "a rolling wall of water": it rolls, it is a wall, and it takes them with it.

new_mechanics.name: carry
new_mechanics.definition: A projectile with carry picks up each light enemy it touches and moves it along with it until it ends; heavy enemies ride half its remaining distance; elites are hit but not carried. If it stops on a wall, every carried body is Crushed by its remaining distance.

new_mechanics.name: width (projectile)
new_mechanics.definition: A projectile may be this wide across its line instead of a point.

good_modifiers.word: Breaking Bore: when it breaks it throws them on
Racing Bore: faster and harder
Long Bore: rolls farther

bad_modifiers.why: it already passes through everything it meets; falls back to a little power
nothing lasts on you; falls back to a little power
drags back toward you the bodies it is carrying away. Maths lets it act; it should not

skills.name: Slack Water
skills.summary: The tide stops to turn. Everything within 4.5 m is interrupted and hangs still for 2 s (60% slower), and the next shove or drag on each of them goes twice as far. Your water reflux drops by 20. No damage.
skills.verb_fit: Slack is "the still moment at the turn of the tide: everything pauses, reflux eases" - both halves, then the tide turns.

new_mechanics.name: stilled
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, 2 s. 60% slower; the next shove or pull on it goes twice as far and ends the status.

new_mechanics.name: vent_reflux
new_mechanics.definition: Lowers the caster's reflux on the skill's affinity by this much when cast.

good_modifiers.word: Turning Tide: the tide turns at once and pushes them out (twice as far, since they are Stilled)
Ebbing Tide: the tide turns inward instead
Full Tide: Soaked too, so the next shove goes three times as far
Wide Slack: a bigger ring

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite in spirit, a sudden jet; no speed and no damage to raise: falls back to a cost cut
nothing to pierce; falls back to a cost cut
the point is that nothing moves; no speed to raise, falls back to a cost cut
